scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units
other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed; any employment, including in the private sector, disqualifies the applicant.
Applicant must have a space or shed for keeping animals.
Applicant must not have previously availed benefits under any departmental scheme for establishing a livestock unit.
Applicant must submit a self‑declaration confirming unemployment and agreement to abide by scheme conditions.
Applicant must be a resident of Haryana; jurisdiction is the place where the animals are kept within the state.
The livestock unit must be financed through a loan from a bank or financial institution.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for piggery units, up to ₹88,200 for sheep/goat units, and a 50% subsidy for dairy units, subject to loan financing.
documents_required: Self‑Declaration for unemployment and compliance with scheme conditions
